title: Batch 8 - lists page, list cards, lists import, add-to-list menu

states.ids: D116, A16, D20, A37, first-screen rule
states.what: Signed in, 3 lists: «Новый список» is the head primary (rule 8); the count line holds «Ещё» (at 360 «Выбрать» and the import, at 1180 the import, with «Выбрать» beside the count, as the catalog); no «Ваш аккаунт» heading (D116), no «Справка» (owner, 2026-10-29); cards with no red «Удалить» and no always-on tick; a card names waiting requests and changes. The account control is lit.
Open and focus: «Новый список» opens the name field in place with a short example, «Создать» and «Отмена».
Open at 360: the title row «Ещё» with «Импорт из файла» (at 1180 the import is a button in the head).
Open: a card's «Ещё» menu: open, download JSON, then delete, apart.
The selection mode: neutral ticks and a lit border (no gold), the bar sticky at the bottom with «Скачать JSON (2)», «Удалить (2)» and «Снять выделение» last.
Empty: no lists yet. The empty-state pattern (batch 3) with the kind glyph well names both ways to start.
Signed out: one sentence on where lists live, «Войти» as the one primary.
Error: the read failed; the cause and «Повторить».

At the limit and many: 50 of 50 in red; «Новый список» stays on and its press says the limit and the next step (today's toast, batch 2); from the eighth list the search; the fold «и ещё 38 списков» (rule 12).
Open: «Ещё» > «Импорт из файла» opens the panel under the head: one summary, the skipped lines on request, no raw ids.
Error page, signed out: a true cause after R10 (no browser lists) and «Войти».
Error page, signed in: names the signed-in account and «Мои списки».

Open: the add-to-list menu: heading «Списки», a check mark (not gold fill) on the lists that hold the item, counts in words («10 позиций»), «Новый список»; it stays open for a second list. At 360 the menu is its own sheet over the item that closes with «Закрыть» (rule 11).
Open, signed out: the menu says where lists live and offers «Войти и создать список».
